item.title: Learn The Fundamentals Of Playing The Dulcimer At The Molino Library
item.description: You can learn the fundamentals of playing the mountain dulcimer at the Molino Library on Monday. The “Fundamentals of Dulcimer” class will be held from 10:30 until 11:30 a.m.. on January 5. The class is free, and no experience or materials are required. Dulcimers are provided for the class. item.title: Three Injured In Highway 29 Crash At Bluff Springs Road
item.description: Three people were injured in a two-vehicle crash Saturday afternoon on Highway 29 south of Century. The crash occurred at about 12:50 p.m. at the intersection of Highway 29 and Bluff Springs Road and involved a GMC Denali and a Ford Expedition. item.title: AAA: Florida Gas Prices Lower Than Last Year, But Global Uncertainty Looms
item.description: Florida drivers are paying less for gasoline than they did a year ago, but uncertainty in global markets could change that, according to AAA. item.title: Escambia County Approves New 30-Year Franchise Agreement With EREC
item.description: Escambia County has approved a new 30-year utility franchise for Escambia River Electric Cooperative. EREC, a member-owned cooperative, was founded in 1939 to bring affordable electric power to Escambia and Santa Rosa counties. item.title: Courtney Geiger Named Lipscomb Elementary Teacher Of The Year, County Top 5 Finalist
item.description: Courtney Geiger was named the Lipscomb Elementary School Teacher of the Year. She has also been selected as a Top 5 finalist for Escambia County Teacher of the Year, with the winner to be announced in the coming weeks. Photo for NorthEscambia.com, click to enlarge.
